listing.name: Wave Race: Blue Storm Recompiled
listing.summary: Explore Wave Race: Blue Storm Recompiled and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Prepare upstream or keep an existing game build
steps.instruction: Follow upstream’s build instructions with your own supported Wave Race: Blue Storm disc. Its Windows game output is waverace.exe; use the ordinary play invocation from the guide unless you deliberately prepare its optional VR mode. Keep the prepared data and working directory with the native player. The source project does not supply a complete game package for Portcove to replace.

steps.title: Keep your files and update through upstream
steps.instruction: Use a separate folder you control and retain your working copy. An existing native player can use Portcove’s non-owning registration after the read-only executable review; choose Play separately. You or upstream keep runtime updates, original files, generated data, saves and settings. Portcove does not replace, back up or roll back this external runtime. Follow the selected upstream version’s instructions when changing it.
